title: Corporate Events

text: Fill out the inquiry form below or call us directly to discuss your event date, group size, and what you need. We'll put together the details and make the rooftop work for your team.

sections.title:
The Rooftop
Is Yours
text: Four stories above 408 Pier View Way — open air, full bar, and a setting that lets the venue make the statement so you don't have to.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop packed with guests at golden hour — bartender at full venue

sections.title: A Space Worth Showing Up For
text:
The rooftop at Coco Cabana is a full open-air venue — cabana lounge seating, a full Caribbean cocktail bar, and a Pacific coastline view that turns any corporate event into something memorable.

Whether you're entertaining a client group, celebrating a team milestone, or activating a brand in front of the right crowd — we can build the event around what you need. Reach out and we'll talk through the options.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge seating with rattan pendants, tile wall, and Oceanside views

steps.title: Inquire Below
steps.text: Fill out the inquiry form with your event date, group size, and what you need from the space. Or call us directly at (858) 304-7725.

steps.title: We Build the Plan
steps.text: We'll follow up within 1 business day to confirm availability and put together the details — space, bar, and anything else your event requires.

steps.title: Enjoy the Rooftop
steps.text: Show up, settle in, and let the rooftop do the rest. We'll handle everything so you can focus on your guests.
